name: SP Group A/S
summary: SP Group A/S engages in the manufacture and supply of moulded plastic and composite components primarily in Denmark, rest of Europe, the Americas, Asia, Australia, and Africa. The company develops and produces fluoroplastic coatings, and PTFE and other refined materials primarily for the healthcare, cleantech, and food-related industries. It also manufactures solid, foamed, flexible, and light-foam polyurethane products for the cleantech industry, as well as produces ventilation equipment, ergonomic mats, and striping products. In addition, the company offers thermo-formed plastic components for cleantech and medical device industries. Further, it provides injection-moulded plastic precision components for a range of industries; packaging for FDA-registered products for customers in the medical device industry; manufactures rotational-moulded precision components for range of industries; offers fenders and buoys to the maritime industry; manufactures blow-moulded plastic precision components for medical device industry; and composite solutions for various raw materials, as well as performs coatings on plastic and metal components. SP Group A/S was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Søndersø, Denmark.
